title: Rooftop rain-garden and tool library
summary: Residents of a 60-unit building will convert an unused roof terrace into a rain garden and stock a shared tool library in the basement. Forty households have signed on to staff it on a rota, and the building owner has agreed to a five-year lease at no charge. Workshops on basic repairs will run monthly for the wider neighbourhood.

title: Free weekend dinghy lessons
summary: A volunteer-run club wants to teach 80 teenagers to sail over one summer. They own two boats, have two certified instructors, and plan to buy safety gear and rent a third boat. There is no plan yet for what happens after the summer, and insurance is still being quoted.
